meta.method: Each statement carried by 2 or more distinct sources and each evidence-catalogue record was rewritten by a language model as one neutral proposition (who did what, when, which record shows it). Propositions were merged when they name the same record with similar wording, when their wording is near-identical, or when a model judged two close propositions to state the same fact. n = distinct primary documents behind a proposition (court, Land Registry, dated press, official or archive records, catalogued evidence), with duplicate labels of one document counted once; estate pages that copy a point add nothing to n. Reconstructions (AR), missing-record pages (MR), person entries (PE) and placeholders for records not yet located are never primary. Model output is not checked line by line.
